title: Identify, assess, disclose, review, and mitigate sustainability impacts
summary: Assess and report the planet, people, and prosperity impacts of digital projects, and plan measurable reductions to the real-world effects of their activity.

title: Understand user requirements or constraints
summary: Identify and involve users and affected communities, and research their needs.

title: Integrate sustainability into every stage of the ideation process
summary: Design and review sustainable branding and experiences, involve users throughout the process, and reduce unnecessary development and environmental impact through early testing and environmentally aware design.

title: Design efficient and streamlined user journeys
summary: Design clear, efficient journeys that help users complete tasks and find content with minimal effort.

title: Design to assist and not to distract
summary: Give users control over notifications and focus, prioritize task-relevant content, and avoid designs that distract or unnecessarily extend engagement.

title: Avoid being manipulative or deceptive
summary: Avoid deceptive patterns, clearly label ads, respect consent for tracking, and ensure search, sharing, and discoverability practices prioritize user needs over optimization or manipulation.

title: Make deliverables understandable and reusable
summary: Create discoverable, maintainable, and reusable documentation and code resources that support long-term understanding, reuse, and sustainability.

title: Use a design system for interface consistency
summary: Use design systems and established patterns to ensure consistent, efficient, and sustainable interfaces through reusable components and clear maintenance practices.

title: Optimize media to reduce resource use
summary: Include media only when it supports user needs. Manage, optimize, and load media efficiently. Ensure users have control over playback and data use.

title: Ensure animation is proportionate and easy to control
summary: Use animation sparingly and efficiently, only when it supports understanding, while limiting performance impact and giving users control over motion.

title: Use optimized web typography
summary: Use font strategies that minimize downloads and complexity while supporting required languages and dynamic content.

title: Avoid unwanted notifications
summary: Send only user-requested notifications and provide clear, accessible controls for managing preferences, opt-in, and account and contact settings.

title: Reduce the impact of downloadable and physical documents
summary: Reduce paper use through digital-first workflows, optimize and reuse accessible downloadable documents, and provide clear, user-controlled document previews and formats.

title: Involve users early in the project
summary: Define and validate prototypes and interface components through user testing to ensure they work effectively in real-world use cases and across diverse user needs.

title: Audit and test for bugs or issues requiring resolution
summary: Regularly audit for issues or problems, running tests at regular intervals in both simulated and real-world scenarios to ensure stability of the project.

title: Validate usability through testing and real-world usage
summary: Monitor user feedback and real usage to evaluate feature effectiveness, and use usability testing and user research to guide ongoing improvements.

title: Provide cross-platform compatibility support
summary: Document compatibility, avoid unnecessary obsolescence, and test across devices, systems, and network conditions.

title: Set goals based on performance and energy impact
summary: Define performance and environmental targets, and design content with awareness of the relative energy and processing cost.

title: Minify and remove unused code
summary: Minify code and data, and remove unused characters to reduce file size and improve loading efficiency and maintainability.

title: Modularize bandwidth-heavy components
summary: Split large components into smaller, on-demand modules to improve loading efficiency while balancing maintainability and caching performance.

title: Avoid redundancy and duplication in code
summary: Reduce code duplication through refactoring and reuse, ensure maintainability, and favor evolving existing solutions over rebuilding them.

title: Treat third parties the same as first parties
summary: Minimize and carefully manage third-party services by using lightweight, user-controlled integrations that are loaded only when needed.

title: Ensure code follows good semantic practices
summary: Use standards-compliant HTML and web platform features, and avoid unnecessary complexity or non-standard code.

title: Defer the loading of non-critical resources
summary: Load non-essential assets asynchronously or with prioritization to improve rendering performance and avoid visual issues.

title: Structure metadata for machine readability
summary: Include essential document metadata and structured data to improve usability, accessibility, and machine readability.

title: Use media queries that support sustainability goals
summary: Support user preferences via media queries for color, motion, contrast, data use, and related settings to improve accessibility and efficiency.

title: Ensure layouts work for different devices and requirements
summary: Use responsive, progressively enhanced, and carbon-aware design to ensure accessible, adaptable functionality across devices and interaction methods while managing resource use.

title: Use sustainable JavaScript and APIs
summary: Write efficient JavaScript and use APIs that minimize processing, data use, and energy consumption.

title: Use dependencies sparingly and maintain them
summary: Regularly review dependencies, remove unused or unnecessary libraries and frameworks, and keep required packages up to date. Opt for minimal, secure, and modular solutions.

title: Include expected and beneficial files
summary: Include standard website metadata and configuration files to support discoverability, transparency, and operational best practices.

title: Use the most efficient solution for your service
summary: Choose lightweight, efficient implementation approaches that balance effort, performance, and environmental impact while favoring simple, native, and static solutions.

title: Use the latest stable language version
summary: Use up-to-date technologies and select the most suitable programming language for each task to ensure efficiency and maintainability.

title: Reduce the number and complexity of database queries
summary: Optimize database use by minimizing and scoping queries, reducing repeated requests, and applying data governance practices.

title: Use sustainable hosting
summary: Select and manage infrastructure using sustainability metrics, prioritizing low-carbon energy use and low-impact hosting and domain choices in selection, and extending hardware lifespan and minimising emissions in management.

title: Optimize caching and support offline access
summary: Use caching and offline capabilities to reduce network load, improve resilience, and balance performance with sustainability.

title: Reduce data transfer with compression
summary: Compress server responses and media files to reduce bandwidth, storage use, and delivery overhead while balancing processing costs.

title: Setup necessary error pages and redirection links
summary: Provide clear error handling and ensure broken links are either fixed or redirected to destinations to prevent navigation issues.

title: Avoid maintaining unnecessary virtualized environments or containers
summary: Remove unnecessary virtualized environments to improve efficiency and maintainability.

title: Use automation wisely
summary: Automate and scale tasks and infrastructure efficiently, run processes only when needed, and control unwanted traffic.

title: Define the frequency of data refreshes
summary: Decide when to refresh data based on a balance of user and sustainability requirements.

title: Back up critical data at routine intervals
summary: Back up data at regular intervals to ensure that there are failsafes that can be relied upon should an issue occur.

title: Assess the impact and requirements of data processing
summary: Use carbon-aware scheduling, efficient and secure protocols, and simple system designs to reduce unnecessary processing while balancing performance, security, and constraints.

title: Use Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) when beneficial
summary: Use CDNs and data location strategically for static content and processing only when they improve efficiency and sustainability, while avoiding unnecessary distribution and transfers.

title: Ensure infrastructure fits project requirements
summary: Use demand-matched, autoscaling infrastructure to meet demand efficiently without overprovisioning.

title: Store data according to the needs of your users
summary: Regularly manage and reduce stored data (including content, logs, media, and downloads) using retention, compression, and lifecycle policies, while maintaining efficient access to long-term assets.

title: Have an ethical and sustainable product strategy
summary: Implement organizational practices around ethics, sustainability, and responsible data use. Publish and maintain policies that demonstrate their implementation.

title: Assign a sustainability advocate
summary: Appoint a sustainability advocate who is provided with what they require to speak about and for issues relating to sustainability.

title: Inform, raise awareness, and train for sustainability
summary: Provide ongoing training, onboarding, and guidance on sustainability practices, and support participation in sustainability initiatives through clear materials, knowledge sharing, and organizational encouragement.

title: Communicate the environmental impact of user choices
summary: Empower users, allowing them to make decisions when their choices can influence the environmental impact they have.

title: Calculate the environmental impact
summary: Assess and compare full life cycle environmental impacts, including those of third-party services, to inform sustainable design decisions.

title: Define clear organizational sustainability goals and metrics
summary: Define measurable sustainability goals and metrics, and communicate progress over time.

title: Validate web sustainability efforts through external verification
summary: Use independent verification to support and improve sustainability claims.

title: Support mandatory disclosures and reporting
summary: Publish transparent, standards-aligned sustainability reports that track progress over time and clearly explain real impact reductions without misleading reporting.

title: Create one or more impact business models
summary: Describe how revenue generation supports environmental and social outcomes.

title: Follow a product management and maintenance strategy
summary: Maintain clear documentation, resourcing, and measurement practices for long-term product support, including security, sustainability, and early detection of failure risks.

title: Implement continuous improvement procedures
summary: Maintain continuous improvement processes that balance feature changes, maintenance, and updates with user value and sustainability outcomes.

title: Document updates and evolutions
summary: Provide documentation to help users find their way whenever functionality changes.

title: Evaluate if a digital product or service is necessary
summary: Assess alignment with sustainability goals, validate product need, and reduce barriers to access, usability, and fairness.

title: Provide a supplier standards of practice document
summary: Select and work with suppliers based on sustainability principles, measure their impact, and transparently publish partnership outcomes.

title: Share economic benefits
summary: Commit to fair pay, align workers and contractors with shared impact goals, and provide employee benefits within available resources.

title: Share decision-making power with affected parties
summary: Involve users and staff in decision-making, ensure human oversight, and provide transparency, and challenge mechanisms for automated decisions.

title: Use Diversity, Equity, Justice, Inclusion (DEJI) practices
summary: Publish and act on Diversity, Equity, Justice, Inclusion (DEIJ) and accessibility commitments, support training and measurable progress, and ensure inclusive outcomes across products and operations.

title: Promote responsible data practices
summary: Respect user data rights and manage data lifecycle through minimized collection, user control, portability, deletion, and content archiving.

title: Establish responsible practices around AI and emerging or disruptive technologies
summary: Ensure responsible use of automated systems by only using ethically sourced and suitably sized data and models, managing environmental impacts, supporting workforce adaptation, respecting user agent controls, and using post-quantum encryption only where justified.

title: Adopt responsible financial practices
summary: Adopt responsible financing practices by divesting from high-carbon assets and aligning budgeting and financial partnerships with long-term sustainability.

title: Adopt organizational philanthropy practices
summary: Align partnerships and corporate giving with the organization's purpose, and support skill-building voluntary and pro bono work through clear partnership and giving policies.

title: Plan for a digital product or service's care and end-of-life
summary: Document when a project is shut down and make users aware of what will happen to their data.

title: Repair, reuse, refurbish, recycle or reduce e-waste
summary: Prioritize repair, reuse, refurbishment, and responsible recycling of hardware and e-waste through certified services, including supporting users doing repairs.

title: Define performance, environmental, and human budgets
summary: Define and apply lifecycle sustainability and performance budgets, set evidence-based KPIs, and track measurable improvements over time.

title: Use and contribute to open source
summary: Define and maintain an open-source policy and actively contribute to open-source communities through code, time, and financial or in-kind support.

title: Create a business continuity and disaster recovery plan
summary: Maintain tested incident response plans and communicate transparently with users about service issues, risks, and recovery.
